about_the_game:
"What? Never seen someone who's odd-eyed before? You think I'll fall for you because you're looking at me?"

Get the chic White Delinquent Cat costume, a vehicle, in-game currencies, and tools in one bundle at a low price! Enjoy life in Play Together with this Starter Pack that's jam-packed with must-have items!

Starter Pack - Chic White Contents:

  • White Delinquent Cat Package

  • Classic Convertible (Green)

  • Amateur Rod

  • Rabbit Ear Bug Net

  • Toy Mallet

  • 100 Gems

  • 20,000 Stars

How to Claim Your Items:

  • Log in to the game and click on the "smartphone" icon located on the right side of the screen.

  • Click on the "Inbox" icon at the bottom.

  • Press the "Receive" button to collect the contents of the DLC pack.

※ This DLC pack does not offer duplicate item refunds, even if you already own some or all of the included items. Please make sure to review the contents first before purchasing.
